title: DESeq2 bundled Pasilla count matrix and sample annotation
study_ids: pasilla RNAi knock-down study; accession not established in inspected source
provenance: DESeq2 vignette says the data are from Drosophila melanogaster cell cultures and investigate RNAi knock-down of splicing factor pasilla, and says source data are provided by the pasilla package. Two copied files are bundled in this repository. This links the assets as representations of the same example study; no extra relationship to other datasets is implied.

biological_context.experimental_units: cell cultures/samples; exact count not verified
biological_context.assay: RNA-seq; detailed production methods deferred to pasilla package vignette
biological_context.design: pasilla knock-down treatment compared with untreated; sequencing type metadata also present

assets.relationship: paired metadata asset for the bundled count matrix; vignette explicitly aligns row names with count columns after removing fb prefix

access_and_terms.access: Public GitHub source package at pinned revision; no download executed
access_and_terms.reuse: DESeq2 package license is LGPL (>=3) per DESCRIPTION; this does not alone establish terms governing underlying study data. Data-specific reuse terms not inspected

inspection: Inspected repository tree metadata and vignette loading/alignment code. Did not download or preview the count matrix or annotation values.
limitations: No accession, exact sample count, checksum, underlying package version, detailed experimental protocol, or data-specific license verified.
Reported asset byte sizes are GitHub tree metadata, not independently checked file sizes at a local copy.

title: tximportData Salmon quantification demonstration assets
kind: transcript quantifications and transcript-to-gene annotation; source example
provenance: DESeq2 vignette loads extdata from Bioconductor tximportData, reads samples.txt and tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv, then labels two samples artificially as conditions A/B for illustration. Source files, underlying study identity, and biological interpretation of these labels were not inspected. Not grouped with Pasilla or airway.

biological_context.assay: Transcript abundance quantification; exact assay details/source unknown
biological_context.design: Artificial condition labels A/B in vignette; not an observed experimental contrast
metadata: sample table fields pop, center, run plus artificial condition

assets.format: Bioconductor package extdata (samples.txt, Salmon quant.sf.gz files, tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv)
assets.stage: transcript-level quantifications and gene mapping; tximport creates estimated gene-level counts and offsets
assets.relationship: Vignette identifies these assets under one tximportData extdata directory and uses samples$run to link quantification files to mapping/sample data

access_and_terms.access: Vignette uses system.file from an installed Bioconductor package; no retrieval attempted
access_and_terms.reuse: No license or reuse evidence for underlying data inspected

inspection: Inspected DESeq2 vignette setup and import code only; no assets or package metadata were retrieved.
limitations: Package release, study accession, exact sample count, organisms, assay protocol, files' checksums, and access terms unknown.
Vignette's two-sample artificial labeling cannot be treated as evidence of a biological A-versus-B contrast.
Estimated count processing stage is source-described; execution not validated.

title: Bottomly-derived mean/dispersion pairs for simulation benchmark
kind: reference product derived from study observations
study_ids: Bottomly study; accession and detailed identity not established
provenance: icobra_benchmarks.R loads meanDispPairs_bottomly.rda and filters by mean >10. An inactive code block loads bottomly_sumexp.RData, sets strain levels C/D, adds batch from experiment.number, estimates size factors/dispersions using DESeq2, then extracts baseMean and dispGeneEst, retaining positive dispersion and nonmissing mean. This is evidence of intended derivation only; required RDA is absent from repository tree and the relationship to source observations is not verified by file inspection.

biological_context.assay: RNA-seq presumed by object naming and workflow context; exact assay not established by inspected source
biological_context.design: Inactive derivation code uses ~batch + strain; not benchmark's generated two-group simulated design
metadata: experiment.number used as batch in inactive code

assets.stage: mean-dispersion reference pairs; absent from repository tree
assets.relationship: Benchmark samples these reference pairs to parameterize simulated count generation

assets.format: RDA expected by inactive derivation block (bottomly_sumexp.RData)
assets.stage: upstream SummarizedExperiment; absent from repository tree

access_and_terms.access: Required serialized assets absent from repository tree; no external retrieval attempted
access_and_terms.reuse: Unknown for underlying study and derived reference

inspection: Inspected benchmark script code and repository tree; did not access RDA files or execute any analysis.
limitations: Study accession, source asset, counts, sample count, reference row count, release, and reuse terms unknown.
Do not treat the simulated benchmark outputs as observations from Bottomly study.
Lineage is only the derivation indicated by an inactive code block; unverified by reading the serialized assets.
